reviewType: AI-assisted factual source review; not clinical approval
scope: Eleven overdue source reviews and the changed Wegovy injection SmPC. No medicine claims, medicine review dates, catalogue-wide date, monitor logic, checkout or navigation changes.
fingerprintMethod: Unmodified monitor.mjs fingerprintSource on complete HTTP 200 responses retrieved at each source's exact checkUrl; source identity validated and no withdrawal detected.

sources.assessment: The 10 August 2026 MHRA announcement supports UK adult weight-management authorisation and a separate type 2 diabetes indication, once-daily prescription use and gastrointestinal adverse effects. Its NHS statement is distinct from approval; the separate current NICE project remains in development. This source does not establish retail stock.

GID-TA11650 remains in progress, with an expected publication date of 18 November 2026 and last listed timeline update 5 August 2026. A planned appraisal date is not a positive funding recommendation. Existing no-confirmed-NHS-access wording remains appropriate.

The 8 November 2023 MHRA decision supports adult weight-management authorisation with diet and activity, weekly injection and common gastrointestinal effects. It is an authorisation record, not evidence of today's stock or NHS eligibility.

TA1026 remains updated 1 September 2025. The overview and recommendation chapter retain eligibility limits and phased NHS England implementation; this is not universal access. Together with the NHS tirzepatide page, they support the existing distinction between primary-care and specialist criteria.

NHS information reviewed 6 May 2026 supports orlistat for obesity alongside diet/activity, prescription Xenical versus lower-dose pharmacy products, eligible NHS use, reduced fat absorption and common oily-stool/urgency effects. It also describes interactions and suitability limitations. No stock guarantee or prescribing advice is added.

The 23 July 2026 sponsor announcement describes investigational once-weekly GIP/GLP-1/glucagon agonism, Phase 3 TRIUMPH-2/3 findings, gastrointestinal adverse events and discontinuations. Cardiovascular estimates include substantial uncertainty and a planned US submission is not approval. Existing research-stage wording is supported; no efficacy ranking, guaranteed outcome, NHS access or retail availability is inferred.

The 24 July 2026 MHRA warning explicitly states that retatrutide is not authorised in the UK and warns against unregulated online products. No later tracked approval was identified in this review. The existing investigational/no-approved-retail distinction remains supported.

TA1152, published 7 May 2026, remains separate cardiovascular-prevention guidance. Its recommendation is for eligible adults with established cardiovascular disease and BMI at least 27, up to a 2.4 mg weekly maintenance dose, subject to the commercial arrangement. It does not establish NHS access to a 7.2 mg dose or the oral formulation.

The 4 September 2023 DHSC article supports specialist weight-management access subject to NICE and private prescription after assessment. Its launch-era supply and pilot statements are historical and are not used as current stock evidence. The Watch already says supply varies.

The complete 22 September 2026 product document supports the existing weekly-injection, weight-management, appetite-mechanism and digestive-effects statements. Sections 4.1–4.8, the mechanism and weight-management findings in 5.1, and sections 5.2–10 were checked. The document describes device-dependent administration of the 7.2 mg dose, including a single-use pen; this is not proof of launch, stock or NHS funding. MASH has separate conditional-authorisation evidence requirements. No dosing instructions, new indication or comparative efficacy claim is added to the bounded Watch card.

The 11 June 2026 authorisation supports adult oral Wegovy weight management alongside diet and activity and states that NHS availability had not been established at approval. The Watch appropriately attributes that dated NHS statement rather than treating authorisation as present supply. Fasting and formulation-specific administration remain important.

TA875 remains updated 4 September 2023. The overview and recommendation chapter retain eligible-adult, specialist-service and maximum two-year conditions, with BMI/comorbidity and commercial-arrangement criteria. This supports the existing indication-specific NHS England wording, not access for every authorised dose or formulation.

uncertainties: The previous Wegovy SmPC full response was not available for a line-by-line historical diff. This record reviews current content against the bounded Watch claims; it does not assert an exhaustive list of changes or a new regulatory decision on 22 September.
Product information and NICE guidance do not confirm pharmacy stock. No clinical approval or expanded prescribing advice is recorded.
